slides.body: Be clear about what you automate, and your workflow will follow.

slides.quote: Great automations reduce decisions, not just clicks.
slides.subtext: Not just faster posting. Claude helps you plan, draft, and ship with judgment built in.

items: Keep a human in the loop
slides.body:
Don't chase full autopilot — automate the boring 80%.
Keep judgment where it matters.

slides.statement: Let Claude draft, plan, and organize — not decide what goes out.
slides.subtextTop: Claude can help outline, design, and schedule.
slides.subtextBottom: But the judgment call? That's yours.

slides.body: Small, consistent systems beat one big automation.
